decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to combo off by casting Allosaurus Rider for free using Nourishing Shoal, and then using Eldritch Evolution or Neoform to sacrifice it and search for a powerful creature such as Griselbrand or Worldspine Wurm. The deck includes cards like Gemstone Mine and Chancellor of the Tangle to generate mana quickly, and includes cards like Pact of Negation to protect the combo. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Serum Visions and Chord of Calling to help find the necessary pieces for the combo.

The key concept of this deck revolves around utilizing card draw and mana acceleration to quickly cast and activate Goblin Charbelcher, using spells like Manamorphose and Pyretic Ritual to generate mana. This is supplemented by recursion spells like Recross the Paths and Bala Ged Recovery to dig for combo pieces and recover important spells from the graveyard. The deck aims to win by dealing lethal damage with Charbelcher's ability, supported by cards like Spikefield Hazard and Fury for removal and protection. Overall, the deck focuses on fast combo potential without relying on traditional land drops.

The deck focuses on using cheap, efficient spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent while deploying aggressive threats such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to quickly end the game. The combination of card advantage from Mishra's Bauble and card selection from Expressive Iteration allows the deck to maintain pressure. Counterspells like Spell Snare and Counterspell are used to protect your threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The UR Aggro deck aims to close out the game quickly with a combination of evasive threats and burn spells.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. The deck contains various control elements such as Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Oblivion Stone to answer threats and dominate the board. The deck also includes powerful threats like Wurmcoil Engine and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to close out the game quickly once control is established. The deck aims to control the game early on and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats in the mid to late game.

The key strategy of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Amulet of Vigor and Sakura-Tribe Elder, and then play powerful lands like Primeval Titan and Urza's Saga to quickly assemble a lethal combination of Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and lands with powerful effects. The deck also utilizes cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to enable even more land plays in a single turn. The goal is to set up a powerful board state that can quickly overwhelm the opponent with a large number of threats and land-based abilities.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with low-cost, efficient spells and creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble, Lightning Bolt, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply early pressure. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Counterspell and Spell Pierce to protect its board state. Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide powerful threats as the game progresses. The deck aims to maintain tempo and efficiency by quickly cycling through its deck with cards like Expressive Iteration and Consider while constantly applying pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly casting powerful spells and creatures with Cascade, overwhelming the opponent with a flurry of spells and aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to cascade into powerful threats like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Negation and Repudiate / Replicate to control the game and protect its aggressive strategy. With a mix of tempo play and explosive threats, this deck aims to outpace and overpower opponents in fast-paced Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on combining the cards Indomitable Creativity and Dwarven Mine to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield early. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide support and card advantage, while cards like Prismari Command and Prismatic Ending offer removal and flexibility. The main goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with fast, unexpected threats. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Spell Pierce helps protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The key concept of this Combo - Hammer Time deck is to quickly assemble the Colossus Hammer combo with Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic, allowing for explosive and aggressive plays. The deck also includes protection spells like Spell Pierce and Giver of Runes to keep the combo safe, as well as Urza's Saga to tutor for key pieces. The deck aims to win the game quickly through powerful equipment synergies and efficient mana usage.

This deck focuses on utilizing the card Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Wrenn and Six from the deck. It also includes cards like Dwarven Mine and Leyline Binding to support the combo strategy. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce provides disruption against opponent's counterplays while cards like Persist and Prismari Command offer versatility in dealing with different situations. The deck aims to surprise opponents with its creative use of cards and generate powerful board presence quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combination of cards like Indomitable Creativity, Archon of Cruelty, and Dwarven Mine to quickly generate powerful threats on the battlefield. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding while also providing additional value through cards like Persist and Wrenn and Six. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Prismari Command adds versatility and flexibility to the deck's game plan, allowing for various creative combos and strategies to be executed.

This deck focuses on using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Wrenn and Six to cheat big creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield quickly. It also utilizes Teferi, Time Raveler to disrupt opponents' plans and protect its own combo pieces. The deck aims to be versatile with cards like Spell Pierce and Prismatic Ending for interaction, while also having some card advantage and selection with cards like Expressive Iteration and Prismari Command. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

This deck focuses on dealing fast and efficient damage to your opponent using burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Boros Charm, while also utilizing aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. The deck aims to apply pressure early in the game, with cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel punishing opponents for playing spells. The mana base is optimized for consistent color fixing and the inclusion of lands like Sunbaked Canyon for additional card draw. Overall, this deck is designed to close out games quickly and overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize.

This Modern Jund Aggro deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Tarmogoyf to apply constant pressure on the opponent. It also includes disruption cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push and Maelstrom Pulse to deal with threats. The deck's main strategy is to quickly establish a board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately overwhelming them with a relentless assault.

The deck utilizes cards that allow for quick mana fixing and control elements to set up a combo involving Indomitable Creativity and Dwarven Mine to cheat out high-costed creatures like Archon of Cruelty. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide additional value and protection for the combo, while cards like Persist and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker help to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. The deck focuses on creating an explosive board state and overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures before they can respond effectively.
